title: stelis arcuata
intro: Stelis arcuata, commonly known as the curved stelis, is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Stelis arcuata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
